name: lit-survey
description: Search and synthesize research literature across arXiv, Semantic Scholar, and Google Scholar. Returns a structured landscape map with gaps, trends, and open problems. Former ARIS skill: /research-lit.

direction.description: Research direction or topic to survey

download.description: Whether to download full PDFs (default: metadata only)

max_results.description: Maximum number of papers to include

landscape.description: Structured research landscape with sub-directions, approaches, gaps

papers.description: List of discovered papers with metadata

gaps.description: Identified structural gaps in the literature
